Library loading
```{r}
library(lme4)
```

Data loading
```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/These/data/meg_maestro/representation_analysis/seeg/corr_and_distance/dual_mechanism_data.csv")

# Make subject a factor
df$subject <- factor(df$subject)
```

glmm
```{r}
model <- glmer(
  correct ~ predicted_similarity + predicted_separability + (1 | subject),
  data = df,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  #control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")  # usually more stable
)

summary(model)
```
